senses.en: lasting or intended to last forever or for a long time

ex.en: After years of short contracts, she finally got a permanent job.
ex.zh: 做了多年的短期約後，她終於得到一份正職工作。

root.note: 一直停留的 → 永久的

senses.en: to spread throughout something

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread will permeate the whole house.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味會瀰漫整間屋子。

root.note: 穿透過去 → 瀰漫

senses.en: allowed by rules or law

ex.en: Is it permissible to bring food into the museum?
ex.zh: 可以帶食物進博物館嗎？

root.note: 可以放行的 → 可允許的

senses.en: each of the possible ways in which a set of things can be arranged

ex.en: Each permutation of the three digits gives a different lock code.
ex.zh: 這三個數字的每一種排列都是不同的密碼。

root.note: 徹底改變順序 → 排列

senses.en: having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or hidden way
senses.zh: 有害的；（潛移默化地）有毒害的

ex.en: Rumors can have a pernicious effect on a community.
ex.zh: 謠言會對社區造成潛移默化的傷害。

parts.m: death, harm 死亡、傷害（= nec/nox）

root.note: 徹底造成傷害 → 有害的

senses.en: at an angle of 90 degrees to a line or surface

ex.en: Draw a line perpendicular to the base of the triangle.
ex.zh: 畫一條垂直於三角形底邊的線。

root.note: 像鉛垂線一樣垂下 → 垂直的

senses.en: a person who commits a crime or harmful act

ex.en: Police are still searching for the perpetrator of the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方仍在搜捕那起搶案的犯人。

root.note: 把（壞事）做完的人 → 犯罪者

senses.en: to make something, often something bad, continue indefinitely

ex.en: Some movies perpetuate harmful stereotypes about women.
ex.zh: 有些電影延續了對女性的有害刻板印象。

root.note: 使持續 → 延續

senses.en: an extra benefit or privilege that comes with a job or position

ex.en: A company car is one perquisite of the manager's job.
ex.zh: 公司配車是經理職位的福利之一。

root.note: 額外獲得的東西 → 津貼

mn: 口語縮寫就是 perk（福利）。別和 prerequisite（先決條件）搞混。

senses.en: cruel treatment of a group because of race, religion, or beliefs

ex.en: Many families fled their homeland to escape religious persecution.
ex.zh: 許多家庭為逃避宗教迫害而離開故鄉。

root.note: 一路追著不放 → 迫害

mn: persecute（迫害）和 prosecute（起訴）容易搞混。

senses.en: continued effort to achieve something despite difficulties

ex.en: Learning a language takes patience and perseverance.
ex.zh: 學習語言需要耐心與毅力。

root.note: 始終嚴格要求自己 → 堅持不懈

senses.en: to keep trying despite difficulty or delay

ex.en: If you persevere, you will eventually pass the exam.
ex.zh: 只要堅持下去，你終究會通過考試。

root.note: 始終嚴格堅守 → 堅持

senses.en: light, joking talk; teasing banter

ex.en: The dinner party was full of witty persiflage and laughter.
ex.zh: 晚宴上充滿了機智的玩笑與笑聲。

root.note: 吹口哨般調侃 → 打趣

senses.en: to continue firmly despite difficulty or opposition
to continue to exist

ex.en: If the symptoms persist, see a doctor.
ex.zh: 如果症狀持續，請去看醫生。

root.note: 一直站著不倒 → 堅持、持續

senses.en: the quality of continuing firmly despite difficulties
the continued existence of something

ex.en: Her persistence finally convinced the company to hire her.
ex.zh: 她的堅持終於說服公司錄用她。

root.note: 一直站著 → 堅持

senses.en: an important or distinguished person

ex.en: The ambassador was treated as a royal personage.
ex.zh: 大使受到皇室貴賓般的禮遇。

root.note: （重要的）人物

senses.en: belonging to or affecting a particular person
relating to someone's private life or feelings

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings with you at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時保管好您的個人物品。

root.note: 個人的

mn: personal（個人的，重音在前）vs. personnel（人員，重音在後）。

senses.en: a person's character and qualities
a famous person, especially in entertainment

ex.en: She has a warm and cheerful personality.
ex.zh: 她的個性溫暖又開朗。

root.note: 個人的特質 → 個性

senses.en: the people employed in an organization
the department dealing with employees

ex.en: Only authorized personnel may enter this area.
ex.zh: 只有經授權的人員可以進入此區。

root.note: 一群人 → 全體人員

senses.en: a particular way of thinking about something; a point of view
the ability to judge the relative importance of things
(art) the technique of showing depth and distance on a flat surface

ex.en: Traveling abroad gave him a new perspective on his own culture.
ex.zh: 出國旅行讓他對自己的文化有了新的看法。

root.note: 看穿 → 觀點、透視

senses.en: having a ready insight into and understanding of things

ex.en: A perspicacious investor saw the company's potential early.
ex.zh: 一位有眼光的投資人很早就看出這家公司的潛力。

root.note: 能看穿的 → 有洞察力的

senses.en: the ability to notice and understand things quickly

ex.en: The editor's perspicacity helped the young writer improve her novel.
ex.zh: 編輯的敏銳眼光幫助那位年輕作家改進了小說。

root.note: 看穿的能力 → 洞察力

senses.en: clearly expressed and easy to understand

ex.en: The manual gives perspicuous instructions for setting up the printer.
ex.zh: 這本手冊對印表機的安裝說明清楚易懂。

root.note: 一眼就能看穿的 → 清楚的

mn: perspicacious 形容「人」有洞察力；perspicuous 形容「文字」清楚。

senses.en: sweat; the process of sweating

ex.en: Beads of perspiration formed on his forehead during the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時，他額頭上冒出了汗珠。

root.note: 透過（皮膚）呼吸 → 出汗

mn: 愛迪生名言：天才是 1% 的 inspiration 加 99% 的 perspiration。

senses.en: to sweat

ex.en: People tend to perspire more when they are nervous.
ex.zh: 人緊張時往往比較會流汗。

root.note: 透過皮膚呼吸 → 出汗

senses.en: able to be persuaded

ex.en: The campaign targeted voters who were still persuadable.
ex.zh: 競選活動鎖定仍有可能被說服的選民。

root.note: 可以被勸動的

senses.en: to cause someone to do or believe something by giving reasons

ex.en: I tried to persuade my parents to let me study abroad.
ex.zh: 我試著說服父母讓我出國念書。

root.note: 徹底勸動 → 說服

senses.en: holding firmly to an opinion or course of action; persistent

ex.en: The pertinacious reporter called the mayor's office every day for a month.
ex.zh: 那位鍥而不捨的記者一個月來每天都打電話到市長辦公室。

root.note: 緊緊抓住不放 → 堅持的

senses.en: the quality of being determined and persistent

ex.en: Through sheer pertinacity, she won the case after five years.
ex.zh: 憑著堅持不懈，她在五年後打贏了官司。

root.note: 緊抓不放的特質

senses.en: relevant to the matter being considered

ex.en: Please include only pertinent information in your report.
ex.zh: 報告中請只放相關的資訊。

parts.m: hold, reach 抓住、延伸（= ten）

root.note: 緊扣著主題的 → 相關的

senses.en: to make someone anxious or unsettled

ex.en: Nothing seems to perturb her, even under great pressure.
ex.zh: 即使在龐大的壓力下，似乎沒有什麼能讓她心煩。

root.note: 徹底攪亂 → 使不安

senses.en: anxiety or mental uneasiness
(science) a small change in a system's normal state or path

ex.en: She hid her perturbation behind a calm smile.
ex.zh: 她用平靜的微笑掩飾內心的不安。

root.note: 被徹底攪亂的狀態 → 不安

senses.en: the act of reading or examining something

ex.en: A quick perusal of the menu showed there were no vegetarian dishes.
ex.zh: 快速瀏覽菜單後發現沒有素食料理。

root.note: 完全用過一遍 → 細讀

mn: peruse 原意是「細讀」，但現在也常用來指「瀏覽」。

senses.en: to spread through every part of something

ex.en: A sense of excitement began to pervade the stadium.
ex.zh: 一股興奮的氣氛開始瀰漫整個體育場。

root.note: 走遍每個地方 → 瀰漫

senses.en: the act of spreading throughout something

ex.en: The pervasion of smartphones has changed how teenagers socialize.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的普及改變了青少年的社交方式。

root.note: 走遍 → 遍及

senses.en: spreading widely throughout an area or group

ex.en: Advertising has become pervasive in modern life.
ex.zh: 廣告在現代生活中已無所不在。

root.note: 走遍各處的 → 普遍的

senses.en: deliberately behaving in an unreasonable or unacceptable way
contrary to what is expected or wanted

ex.en: He takes a perverse pleasure in arguing with everyone.
ex.zh: 他以跟每個人唱反調為樂，實在很乖張。

root.note: 轉到錯的方向 → 乖張的

senses.en: the distortion or corruption of something from its original purpose
abnormal or unacceptable behavior

ex.en: The verdict was a perversion of justice.
ex.zh: 這項判決是對正義的扭曲。

root.note: 轉向錯誤 → 歪曲

senses.en: a deliberate desire to behave unreasonably

ex.en: Out of sheer perversity, he wore shorts to the formal dinner.
ex.zh: 他純粹為了唱反調，穿短褲去參加正式晚宴。

root.note: 故意轉向錯的方向

senses.en: to distort or misuse something for a bad purpose
[ˋpɝvɝt] a person with abnormal sexual behavior

ex.en: Bribes can pervert the course of justice.
ex.zh: 賄賂可能妨礙司法公正。

root.note: 轉到錯的方向 → 曲解

senses.en: allowing water or other liquid to pass through
open to arguments or ideas

ex.en: Pervious pavement lets rainwater soak into the ground.
ex.zh: 透水鋪面能讓雨水滲入地下。

root.note: 有路可穿過的 → 可滲透的

mn: 反義字 impervious（不透水的；不受影響的）更常考。

senses.en: a deadly epidemic disease, such as the plague

ex.en: The ancient city was struck by war, famine, and pestilence.
ex.zh: 那座古城遭受戰爭、饑荒與瘟疫的打擊。

root.note: 瘟疫

senses.en: deadly or harmful; causing disease
senses.zh: 致命的；有害的；引起瘟疫的

senses.en: (informal) annoying

ex.en: The pestilent swamp air made many workers sick.
ex.zh: 有害的沼澤空氣讓許多工人生病。

root.note: 帶來瘟疫的

senses.en: relating to or causing a deadly disease
(informal) very annoying

ex.en: Pestilential mosquitoes spread fever through the village.
ex.zh: 帶病的蚊子在村子裡傳播熱病。

root.note: 瘟疫的

senses.en: (peter out) to decrease gradually and then stop

ex.en: By evening, the rain began to peter out.
ex.zh: 到了傍晚，雨漸漸停了。

senses.en: to make someone so frightened that they cannot move
to turn organic matter into stone

ex.en: Spiders petrify my little brother.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛會把我弟弟嚇得動彈不得。

root.note: 變成石頭 → 石化、嚇呆

senses.en: childish bad temper or sulkiness

ex.en: The player threw his racket in a fit of petulance.
ex.zh: 那名選手一時鬧脾氣把球拍摔了。

root.note: 動不動就攻擊 → 任性、鬧脾氣

senses.en: bad-tempered and sulky in a childish way
senses.zh: 任性的；使性子的；易怒的

ex.en: The petulant child refused to eat anything but ice cream.
ex.zh: 那個任性的小孩除了冰淇淋什麼都不吃。

root.note: 動不動就發作 → 任性的

senses.en: an official book listing medicines and how to prepare them; a stock of drugs

ex.en: The herb is listed in the national pharmacopoeia.
ex.zh: 這種藥草收錄在國家藥典中。

root.note: 製藥的書 → 藥典

senses.en: a store where medicines are prepared and sold
the science of preparing medicines

ex.en: You can pick up your prescription at the pharmacy.
ex.zh: 你可以到藥局領取處方藥。

root.note: 藥物 → 藥局、藥學

senses.en: remarkable or extraordinary
relating to phenomena perceived by the senses

ex.en: The app has enjoyed phenomenal success among teenagers.
ex.zh: 那款應用程式在青少年之間大受歡迎。

root.note: 顯現出來的 → 現象的；引申為驚人的

senses.en: a fact or event that can be observed, especially one that is unusual
a remarkable person or thing

ex.en: The northern lights are a stunning natural phenomenon.
ex.zh: 北極光是一種壯麗的自然現象。

parts.m: 名詞字尾（希臘文被動分詞）

root.note: 顯現出來的事物 → 現象

senses.en: (of a man) to have casual affairs with many women

ex.en: In the novel, the rich count continues to philander despite being married.
ex.zh: 在小說中，那位富有的伯爵婚後仍然到處拈花惹草。

root.note: 原指「愛丈夫的」，後轉為男人到處調情

senses.en: generous in helping others, especially by giving money to good causes

ex.en: The foundation supports many philanthropic projects in rural areas.
ex.zh: 該基金會支持許多鄉村地區的慈善計畫。

root.note: 愛人類的 → 慈善的

senses.en: a person who gives money and time to help others

ex.en: A local philanthropist donated money to build the new library.
ex.zh: 一位當地慈善家捐款興建新圖書館。

root.note: 愛人類的人 → 慈善家

senses.en: the desire to help others, especially by donating money

ex.en: After retiring, she devoted herself to philanthropy.
ex.zh: 退休後，她投身慈善事業。

root.note: 愛人類 → 慈善

senses.en: the collection and study of postage stamps

ex.en: My uncle's hobby is philately, and he owns thousands of stamps.
ex.zh: 我叔叔的嗜好是集郵，他擁有好幾千張郵票。

parts.m: tax-free 免稅（希臘文 ateleia，指郵資已付）

root.note: 喜愛已付郵資的憑證 → 集郵

senses.en: devoted to music (used in the names of orchestras)
senses.zh: 愛好音樂的（用於交響樂團名稱）

senses.en: a symphony orchestra

ex.en: We have tickets to hear the city philharmonic on Friday.
ex.zh: 我們有星期五市立愛樂樂團演出的票。

root.note: 喜愛音樂的

senses.en: a person who likes or admires women

ex.en: The author, a true philogynist, wrote many strong female characters.
ex.zh: 那位作家是真正尊重女性的人，塑造了許多堅強的女性角色。

root.note: 喜愛女性的人

senses.en: a scholar of the history and development of languages
senses.zh: 語文學家；歷史語言學家

ex.en: J. R. R. Tolkien was a philologist before he became a famous novelist.
ex.zh: 托爾金在成為知名小說家之前是一位語文學家。

root.note: 喜愛文字的人 → 語文學家

senses.en: the study of the history and structure of languages, especially in literary texts

ex.en: She studied classical philology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學攻讀古典語文學。

root.note: 喜愛文字的學問

senses.en: to think or talk about serious matters, often at length

ex.en: My uncle likes to philosophize about the meaning of life after dinner.
ex.zh: 我叔叔喜歡在飯後大談人生的意義。

root.note: 進行哲學思考

senses.en: the study of the nature of knowledge, reality, and existence
a set of beliefs or principles that guides behavior

ex.en: The coach's philosophy is that effort matters more than talent.
ex.zh: 這位教練的理念是努力比天分更重要。

root.note: 愛智慧 → 哲學

senses.en: calm and not easily excited or upset
senses.zh: 冷靜的；不易激動的；冷漠的

ex.en: Even when the plane shook, the phlegmatic pilot stayed calm.
ex.zh: 即使飛機晃動，那位沉著的機師仍保持冷靜。

root.note: 古代體液說：黏液過多的人性情冷淡 → 冷靜的

senses.en: relating to speech sounds; representing each sound with one symbol

ex.en: The dictionary uses phonetic symbols to show pronunciation.
ex.zh: 字典用音標來標示發音。

root.note: 聲音的 → 語音的

senses.en: relating to sound or speech sounds

ex.en: The teacher uses a phonic approach to help children read new words.
ex.zh: 老師用自然發音法幫助孩子讀出生字。

root.note: 聲音的

senses.en: a symbol representing a speech sound or word
(old use) a sound recording

ex.en: In the Chinese character for "ocean," one part is a phonogram that hints at the sound.
ex.zh: 「洋」這個字裡有一部分是提示讀音的聲符。

root.note: 寫下聲音的符號

senses.en: the study of the sound system of a language

ex.en: Phonology explains why English speakers find some Chinese tones hard to hear.
ex.zh: 音韻學解釋了為什麼說英語的人很難聽出某些中文聲調。

root.note: 研究聲音的學問

senses.en: light given off by a substance without noticeable heat, often continuing after exposure to light

ex.en: At night, the waves glowed with a blue phosphorescence.
ex.zh: 夜裡，海浪閃著藍色的磷光。

root.note: 帶光的狀態 → 磷光

senses.en: relating to electricity produced or affected by light

ex.en: Einstein won the Nobel Prize for explaining the photoelectric effect.
ex.zh: 愛因斯坦因解釋光電效應而獲得諾貝爾獎。

root.note: 光與電的

senses.en: an instrument for measuring the intensity of light

ex.en: The photographer used a photometer to check the lighting.
ex.zh: 攝影師用測光表檢查光線。

root.note: 測量光的儀器

senses.en: the science of measuring the intensity of light

ex.en: Astronomers use photometry to measure the brightness of stars.
ex.zh: 天文學家用光度測量法測定恆星的亮度。

root.note: 測量光的學問

senses.en: a scientist who studies physics

ex.en: The physicist explained black holes in simple language.
ex.zh: 那位物理學家用淺白的語言解釋黑洞。

root.note: 研究自然（物理）的人

mn: physicist 是物理學家，physician 是醫師。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, motion, and force

ex.en: Physics helps us understand why the sky is blue.
ex.zh: 物理學幫助我們了解天空為什麼是藍色的。

root.note: 研究自然的學問 → 物理學

senses.en: an 18th-century French economic theory that land and agriculture are the source of all wealth

ex.en: Physiocracy taught that farming, not trade, creates a nation's wealth.
ex.zh: 重農主義主張國家財富來自農業而非貿易。

root.note: 由自然（法則）主導 → 重農主義

senses.en: a person's facial features or expression
the practice of judging character from facial features

ex.en: The painter captured the old sailor's weathered physiognomy.
ex.zh: 畫家捕捉到老水手飽經風霜的面容。

root.note: 從外表判斷本性 → 面相學；相貌
